title: Community learning platform · SWOT scan
subtitle: Four lenses organise hypotheses; each item still needs evidence and an owner

cells.label: S  Strengths
items: Peer mentors already share practical examples
Short lessons fit existing study routines
Pilot groups can test changes in stages

cells.label: W  Weaknesses
items: Learner goals are not yet consistently captured
Content quality needs a review path
Facilitator time is limited during peak terms

cells.label: O  Opportunities
items: Libraries and clubs can provide local cohorts
Open resources can widen practice choices
Lightweight feedback can guide the next lesson

cells.label: T  Threats
items: Partner schedules may change without notice
Access needs can be missed without inclusive review
External platforms may change integration rules

footer: Original teaching canvas · statements are hypotheses, not organisational facts
